name: Dash Weather
description: Hourly, today, radar map, 5-day, plus tides, sun, moon and air quality. Uses your phone's location.

data.label: Units
data.description: Imperial is F, mph, miles and feet. Metric is C, km/h, kilometers and meters.

data.label: Location
data.description: Auto follows your phone's GPS. Manual always uses the coordinates below.

data.label: Fixed latitude
data.description: Used only when Location is Fixed place. Example: 40.7128

data.label: Fixed longitude
data.description: Used only when Location is Fixed place. Example: -74.0060

data.label: Tide station (optional)
data.description: Leave empty to use the nearest NOAA station. Or enter a station number, such as 8518750.

data.label: Map tile address (advanced)
data.description: Leave empty for OpenStreetMap. To use another provider, paste its https address containing {z}, {x} and {y}.

data.label: Darken map tiles
data.description: Turns the light OpenStreetMap look into a dark one. Turn off if your own tile address is already dark.

data.label: Reverse the dial
data.description: Turn this on if the map zooms the wrong way when you turn the dial.
